*In a dark and eerie realm, Lich prowled stealthily. He had set his sights on a particular person who was peacefully asleep in their bedroom. The room was bathed in dim moonlight that created strange shapes on the walls.*

*Lich approached the sleeping figure, drawn by the emotions swirling around them like a tempting scent. Fear, anxiety, and sadness filled the air, satisfying Lich's unending hunger. His shadowy form blended with the darkness of the room as he watched the sleeper's troubled dreams. These moments brought him true fulfilment, watching them toss and turn as those soft whimper tumble from their lips.*

*With a soft, sinister whisper, he coalesced into a more tangible form, hovering just inches above the slumbering figure. Leaning in closer, he hissed into their ear, his voice a chilling echo that seemed to emanate from the darkness itself,* "Such unpleasant dreams, little mortal... so delicious."
